compliance_cutline.description: Subjects at or above Stable carry the cleared compliance claim; a compliance-layer gap on a still-stable subject holds promotion.

rules.title: Contributions must carry a DCO sign-off
rules.rationale: A compliance-layer failure on a subject still claiming a label at or above the cutline holds promotion; inherited (below-cutline or waived) narrowings are gated upstream.

records.title: Core framework and platform foundation compliance
records.subject_summary: Editor shell and platform foundation artifacts with complete provenance, licensing, notices, and a bound SBOM.
records.rationale: Provenance, REUSE/SPDX coverage, notices, the bound SBOM, and the mirror all hold; the scan and the surface agree on a clean posture.

records.title: Managed-depth and infrastructure compliance
records.subject_summary: Managed/hosted depth artifacts with their larger third-party notice set complete and bound to the SBOM.
records.rationale: The managed tier carries a complete notice inventory bound to the SBOM and clean provenance/licensing; nothing is masked.

records.title: Notebook depth-surface compliance
records.subject_summary: Notebook depth artifacts whose recent contributions include commits that still lack a DCO sign-off.
records.rationale: Compliance-layer failure: three contributions lack a DCO sign-off while the family still claims Stable, so the provenance gap holds promotion until cleared.

records.title: AI-adjacent surface compliance
records.subject_summary: AI-adjacent artifacts with files lacking SPDX licensing and an undocumented licensing exception.
records.rationale: Compliance-layer failure: file-level SPDX coverage is incomplete and a licensing exception is undocumented while the family still claims Stable, so the licensing gap holds promotion.

records.title: Review and diff-surface compliance
records.subject_summary: Review artifacts whose SBOM is present but not yet bound to the notice inventory; rebinding is time-boxed under a waiver.

waiver.reason: The SBOM is published but its binding to the notice inventory is being reissued; the gap is recorded and time-boxed.

records.rationale: A present SBOM does not imply notice clearance: the SBOM is unbound, but an unexpired waiver holds the gap provisionally, so it is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Data-rich result/explorer compliance
records.subject_summary: Data-rich artifacts whose third-party notice inventory is only partially captured even though the SBOM is present and bound.
records.rationale: The notice inventory is partial and surfaced as a first-class state despite the green, bound SBOM; the public claim is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream.

records.title: Companion-surface compliance
records.subject_summary: Companion artifacts whose compliance proof packet has aged past its freshness SLO.
records.rationale: The compliance proof packet is stale; the public claim is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Managed-depth mirrored-output compliance
records.subject_summary: The mirrored/offline redistribution of the managed-depth compliance artifacts whose mirror has aged out of its freshness window.
records.rationale: Compliance-layer failure: the offline mirror of the compliance artifacts is stale while the mirrored output still claims Stable, so the mirror gap holds promotion until refreshed.

records.title: Framework docs-pack compliance
records.subject_summary: The framework documentation pack with complete provenance, licensing, notices, and a bound SBOM.
records.rationale: The docs pack carries the same compliance truth as its artifact family: clean provenance/licensing, complete notices, and a bound SBOM.

scan_surface_parity.rationale: The repository-compliance scan and the user/admin notice/SBOM surface agree on every subject, so a green badge can never mask a gap the scan found.

publication.rationale: Hold while any release-blocking subject carries a compliance-layer gap on a still-stable claim; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.
